label: TP
reason: The CodeQL alert correctly identifies two XSS paths: (1) Cookie value flows directly into response.getWriter().println(...) which writes HTML content, and (2) Cookie name flows into response.getWriter().println(...) which also writes HTML content. Neither path performs any encoding/sanitization before writing to the HTTP response body, allowing attackers to inject arbitrary scripts via the cookie.

evidence.note: Cookie value retrieved via getValue() is concatenated into response.getWriter().println() without encoding
Cookie name retrieved via getName() is concatenated into response.getWriter().println() without encoding
